subject: Mobile Development
title: Windows Phone: Microsoft's Billion-Dollar Mistake
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Windows Phone: Microsoft's Billion-Dollar Mistake.

hook.text: Microsoft spent billions building Windows Phone. Reviewers praised its design.

buildup.text: The Live Tile interface was fresh and original. Users genuinely loved the experience.

discovery.text: But developers didn't build apps for it. No Instagram, no Snapchat, no banking apps.

twist.text: Without apps, users left. Without users, developers wouldn't build apps. A death spiral.

climax.text: Microsoft killed Windows Phone in 2017, writing off $7.6 billion in losses.

punchline.text: Great design can't survive without apps.

quiz.question: Why did Windows Phone fail?
options: Developers wouldn't build apps for it
